input.summary: Replace Singapore governing law and exclusive Singapore jurisdiction with New York law, leaving the New York County venue in 28.2 to operate.
input.comment: [Playbook] We require New York governing law, so we have replaced the Singapore law and exclusive Singapore courts in 28.1, which also conflicted with the New York County venue already agreed in 28.2. Delaware, California or England and Wales law with the corresponding courts would be our fallback.

ops.oldText: governed exclusively by Singapore law, and the courts of Singapore have exclusive jurisdiction
ops.newText: governed by the laws of the State of New York
